purpose: The Firecracker VMM binary. Started by orchestrator (typically via the jailer). Reads API requests from a Unix socket and runs one microVM per process.

flags.name: --api-sock
flags.doc: Unix Domain Socket path for the API server. Default: /tmp/firecracker.socket.

flags.name: --id
flags.doc: Microvm identifier (alphanumeric + hyphen). Reflected in metrics and logs.

flags.name: --config-file
flags.doc: Pre-load full VM config from a JSON file; auto-starts the VM. Skip API calls entirely.

flags.name: --log-path
flags.doc: Bootstrap logger to a FIFO before the API would normally configure it.

flags.name: --boot-timer
flags.doc: Emit a boot-timer metric on first guest jiffy.

flags.name: --no-api
flags.doc: Disable the API server (only meaningful with --config-file).

flags.name: --no-seccomp
flags.doc: Disable seccomp filtering — DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Insecure.

flags.name: --seccomp-filter
flags.doc: Override default seccomp filters with a custom seccompiler-bpf-compiled file.

flags.name: --gdb-socket
flags.doc: Enable in-guest GDB stub on a Unix socket. Pairs with --no-seccomp typically.

examples.expected_output: Process runs; awaits API requests on /tmp/fc.sock
VM auto-boots from JSON config; no API server

purpose: Probe a running Firecracker via its API socket. Returns instance state (Not started|Running|Paused) and version.

flags.name: --unix-socket
flags.doc: Required — API uses UDS, not TCP.

purpose: Diagnose host-side OOM during Firecracker startup. fc_vmm: page allocation failure messages indicate the host can't satisfy a high-order allocation (KVM needs contiguous pages for the guest).

examples.expected_output: Lines like 'fc_vmm: page allocation failure: order:6, mode:...' if memory-fragmented host
examples.scenario: Firecracker won't start; OOM exit code 12

purpose: Raise the kernel's minimum-free-memory watermark to combat memory fragmentation that causes Firecracker page allocation failures.
Unload VirtualBox kernel module that holds /dev/kvm exclusively, freeing it for Firecracker. Needed when Firecracker fails with 'Resource busy'.

examples.expected_output: /dev/kvm released; Firecracker can now acquire it
examples.scenario: Conflict with VirtualBox on dev workstation

purpose: Verify the KVM kernel modules are loaded (kvm + kvm_intel or kvm_amd). Without these, Firecracker can't open /dev/kvm.

examples.expected_output: Lines for kvm + kvm_intel or kvm_amd if loaded

purpose: Verify the calling user has read+write access to /dev/kvm. Typically requires being in the 'kvm' group; jailer drops to a lower uid that must also have access.

examples.expected_output: crw-rw---- 1 root kvm 10, 232 ... ; users in kvm group

purpose: Configure vCPU + memory for the microVM. Pre-boot only.
Boot the configured microVM. Synchronous: returns 204 once vCPUs are running.

examples.expected_output: 204; if missing pre-boot config (boot-source / machine-config), returns 400 with fault_message

purpose: Inject Ctrl+Alt+Del into the guest. With reboot=k in boot_args, terminates the Firecracker process gracefully (x86 only).
Force an immediate metrics emission to the configured /metrics FIFO without waiting for the 60-second cadence.

examples.scenario: Capture metrics on demand for an investigation

purpose: Create the named pipe Firecracker requires for /logger and /metrics endpoints. Must exist before PUT /logger or PUT /metrics.

examples.expected_output: FIFOs created; reader process should attach before Firecracker fills the buffer
